tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu lta ba spyi khyab tu

ngo sprod pa'i khrid yig bzhugs so/ / na mo gu ru de wa ḍā kī ya/ mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs rdzogs shing*/ /phul byung mdzad pa'i 'od dkar drwa ba can/ /rig 'dzin rgyu skar bye bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /skyabs gsum ngo bo dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ / thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang he ru ka /rdo rje 'chang dbang rigs lnga zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bde chen sgyu ma'i gar gyis rnam rol ba/ /yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gsang ba kun sdud rdo rje chos/ /dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ /shrī sing ha rig 'dzin padma 'byung*/ /bai ro la sogs snga 'gyur brgyud pa dang*/ /sa ra ha pa klu sgrub yab sras zhabs/ /nā ro mai trī jo bo yab sras dang*/ /dam pa sangs rgyas mar mi yab sras dang*/ /rgya bod mkhas grub kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan skyes bde chen lag mthil gter bzhin du/ /mngon sum ston mdzad 'jam dbyangs bla ma dang*/ /rtsam por yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi zhal gyi gdams pa bri bar bya/ / de yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon byon pa'i mkhas grub chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa'i theg pa chen po'i lta ba'i srol chen po 'di la gsum ste/ dbu ma chen po dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'o zhes bzhed la/ de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel tshul yang mang du byung ba las/ rtsam por yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi man ngag la brten nas de gsum ga'i dgongs pa thun mong ba nyams su len tshul gyi gnad mthun pa rnams kyi 'khrid tshul phyogs gcig tu ston pa la chos spyi'i lta ba'am/ lta ba spyi khyab tu ngo sprod pa zhes pa'i 'khrid tshul byas nas snying thig thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid kyi ngo sprod rnams kyi sngon du ston par mdzad pas de nyid 'dir bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /des na 'di 'chad pa la gnyis/

bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par lta ba spyi khyab tu ngo sprod pa'i tshul dang*/ lta ba zab mo la bag chags bzhag pa'i phyir rje btsun tsong kha pa'i dgongs pa cung zad bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /dang po la gdams pa la yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir chos dang brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ zab lam gyi snod du bsgrub pa'i phyir thun mong ba'i lam la blo sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po la brgyud pa'i che ba dang brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi rim pa dang*/ chos kyi che ba gnyis te gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dngos grub gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten tshul/ dal 'byor gyi rten rnyed dka' zhing don che tshul/ 'jig par sla zhing nam 'chi nges med bsam pa/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal bsams te skyabs su 'gro tshul/ dkar nag gi las kyi 'bras bu bsams nas blang dor bya tshul/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams te zhen log gi blo sgrub pa/ sems can thams cad kyis pha ma byas tshul bsams nas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems la slob tshul/ sangs rgyas gyi yon tan bsams nas de thob phyir rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la slob tshul te lam rim rnams su shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtso bo dbang bskur rnam dag thob pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa srung ba/ thun so so'i sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yi ge brgya pa'i cho ga /ku su lu'i tshogs gsog dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa dpyad de gnyug ma lhan cig skyes par ngo sprad pa dang*/ ngo 'phrod nas don de nyams su len pa'i tshul dang*/ nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs dang sa lam gyi rim pa skye tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ byung gnas 'gro gsum gyis gnas lugs kyi tshang btsal ba dang*/

sku gsum ngo sprod kyi gnyug ma'i rang zhal bstan pa dang*/ gnyug sems la brtan pa thob phyir gnas cha skyong tshul 'phros dang bcas te bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro rnams kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par rgyud la skye nges pa byung ba dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis thugs yid gcig tu bsre ste/ mos ka dag gi ngang la lhod glod nas 'jog pa la sems kyi gnas cha rnyed pa'am de la cung zad goms pa na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams srid zhi'i skyon thams cad las grol ba dang*/ rang res sems can rnams rigs drug tu 'khyam zhing sdug bsngal myong ba'i byed pa po ni tshangs pa'am/ khyab 'jug gam/ dbang phyug gam/ bdag rtag pa'am/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi nang nas gang yin/ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams gang nas byung*/ gang gis sgrub snyam na/ snang srid 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems nyid 'di yin te/ sa ra has/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ /ces dang*/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ / 'dod pa'i 'bras bu nye bar ston byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang*/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sems de yang byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi sgo nas gzhi rtsa dpyad de/ dang po byung sa ni/ phyi snod kyi sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal gang nas byung*/ ji ltar byung*/ tshul ji ltar byung*/ nang bcud kyi sems can pha ma nye 'brel dang*/ rang gi lus kyi phyi nang sogs gang nas byung*/ tshul ji ltar byung rnams legs par brtag cing dpyad de bsgom/ de nas rang gi sems zhes mi dran dgu dran/ mi rig dgu rig khyod/ dang po byung sa gang nas byung*/ ngo bo ji lta bu/

khyed las gang byed/ da lta lus kyi phyi nang stod smad gang la gnas/ ji ltar gnas/ mtha' ma gang du 'gro /byung sa dang 'gro sa med pa'i stong pa yin na/ rigs drug tu 'khyam zhing 'khrul ba'i rgyu ci yin zhib tu brtag cing dpyad do/ /de la dri ba gtsang ba zhig ma byung na khyad par gyi man ngag 'di ltar bya ste/ jo bo rjes/ nyon mongs rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe/ /rgya khras bye'u ded pa ltar/ / dmigs su skor la bkar ded gyis/ /lag tu zin tshe brlag par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dod chags can yul yid du 'ong ba las sems btsal ba ni/ rang gi mdun du gang la chags shing yid du 'ong ba'i yul de yang yang bsgom/ mngon sum pa lta bur gsal zhing chags zhen skyes pa na/ chags zhen de la yul du snang tshul ji ltar snang yang snang ba ltar grub bam ma grub blta ba dang*/ chags zhen gyi jo kho rang dbyibs dang kha dog ngo bo dang byed las ji ltar 'dug blta ba dang*/ jo de dang po gang nas skyes/ da lta gang na 'dug /lus kyi phyi nang gang na gnas blta'o/ /zhe sdang che ba'i rigs dgra la brten nas sems btsal ba ni/ rang dang mi mthun pa'i dgra de mdun du dmigs la khos rang la gnod pa byas pa rnams yang yang dran pas zhe sdang drag po dum dum skyes pa na sems byin po zhe sdang sgom bzhin pa la sems kyi cha shas phra mo zhig gis zhe sdang de la dgra de snang tshul ji ltar snang bltas pa na gang la yang ma bltos par tshugs thub tu ling nge grub 'dug snyam pa snang na dgag bya'i snang tshul ngos zin pa yin pas/ dgra de gang la yang ma bltos par grub na/ dang por pha ma'i rgyu rkyen/ bar du rang dang mthun pa dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen ka /da lta sems kyis dran na zhe sdang skye/ ma dran na brjed nas mi skye ba/ mtha' ma 'chi ba sogs med dgos pa las de ltar 'dug pa ci yin brtag pa dang*/ yang zhe sdang kho rang dbyibs dang kha dog ngo bo byed las ji ltar 'dug lta ba dang*/

dung sems can gnyen la brten nas sems btsal ba ni/ rang la shin tu nye ba'i nye du rnams mdun du dmigs nas/ des phan btags pa rnams dran te gsal ba ni/ yul de ji ltar snang ba dang*/ snang ba ltar grub ma grub blta ba dang*/ de bzhin du tshong pa khe spogs la brten nas sems btsal ba/ bkres skom can zas skom la brten nas sems btsal ba/ nga rgyal can khengs pa la brten nas sems btsal ba sogs slob ma'i rigs dang bstun pa'i 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /rnam byang phyogs la brten pa la/ dad pa can bla ma la brten nas sems btsal ba ni rang gang mos kyi bla ma de'i sku'i rnam pa/ gsung gi nga ro/ thugs kyi mkhyen pa yang yang dran nas gsal bdo ba na/ dad pa de la bla ma snang tshul ji ltar snang dang*/ der grub ma grub dang*/ dad pa de lus kyi phyi nang gang na 'dug ngo bo byed las ji ltar yin dang*/ shes rab can rig gnas la brten nas sems btsal ba/ rtsod pa can lta grub la brten nas sems btsal ba/ nyan thos 'dul khrims la brten nas sems btsal ba/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje la brten nas sems btsal ba/ bskyed rim pa lha sku la brten nas sems btsal ba/ rdzogs rim pa rtsa rlung la brten nas sems btsal ba sogs sngar bzhin shes par bya'o/ /yang skabs skabs su blo de dag gsal bdo ba na/ de'i yul dang blo kho rang gi ngo bo la lta rtog mi byed cing*/ yid byed gzhan yang bkag nas rang babs su 'jog pa rnams res mos byas te btsal lo/ /sems kyi rdar sha gcod tshul 'dis sems ngo 'phrod nas kyang yang yang bya dgos te/ u rgyan rin po ches/ ma gzhi stong pa nyid kyi zhi gnas su/ /rnam rtog thar 'ded stong skor rem du gyis// zhes dang rtog pa rags dus nang du mkhan po tshol/ /ched du spang blang mi dgos rang sar zhog /ces dang*/ dam pa rin po ches/ stong pa'i ngang du rig pa'i mdung skor gyis/ /lta ba thogs rdugs med do ding ri ba/

/zhes so/ /'di lta bu'i sems 'tshol lugs ni gzhung chen po rnams kyi dgongs pa yang yin te/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ brtags pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ /de yi dngos med 'dzin ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ 'jug pa las/ nyon mongs skyon rnams ma lus 'jigs tshogs la/ /lta las byung bar blo yis mthong gyur cing*/ /bdag ni de yi yul du rtogs byas nas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bdag ni 'gog par byed/ /ces dang*/ rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin de/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sku gsum gyi ngo sprod kyis gnyug ma'i rang zhal bstan pa ni/ de ltar dpyad pas 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad don la yod ma myong ba'i gzhi med rtsa bral/ ka ye nas dag pa'i stong pa bden med du 'dug snyam du nges pa na/ dang por byung sa med pas sems nyid rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa chos sku/ bar du gnas sa med pas stong gsal 'dzin med kyi rig pa rjen pa longs sku/ mtha' mar 'gro sa med kyang gdangs 'gag med du shar ba sprul sku'o/ /zhes sku gsum gyi bsgrub gzhi rang la rang chas su yod pa'i gzhi'i sku gsum de/ bla ma'i man ngag gi lam gyi sku gsum dang ma bu bsres te ngo sprad par bya ste/ klong gsal las/ sems la byung sa ma rnyed na/ /sems nyid stong par thag kyang bcad/ /stong pa gzung yul bral ba de/ / chos kyi sku ru ngo yang sprad/ /ces dang*/ stong la ngos bzung bral ba de/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru ni/ /stong la 'gag med ngo yang sprad/ /ces dang*/ sems nyid skye 'gag med pa de/ /sprul pa'i sku ru ngo yang sprad/ /de ltar sems la sku gsum tshang*/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sems kyi ngo bo dang rang bzhin yang don dam par gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngang du rtse gcig tu bzhag ste dkon brtsegs las/ 'od srung sems ni nang na yang med/ phyi rol na yang med/

gnyis ka na yang med cing mi dmigs so/ /sems ni gzugs med pa/ bstan du med pa/ thogs pa med pa'o/ / sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang ma gzigs/ mi gzigs/ gzigs par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems ni dbang sogs la mi gnas/ /gzugs sogs la min bar na'ang min/ /nang na sems min phyi na'ang min/ /gzhan du yang ni rnyed ma yin/ /gang zhig lus min gzhan du'ang min/ /'dres min logs su'ang 'gar min pa/ /de ni cung zad min de'i phyir/ /sems kyi rang bzhin mya ngan 'das/ /zhes so/ /des na chos thams cad stong pa'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog byung na blo de'i ngo bo la bltas te/ rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas de'i ngang la bzhag go /de'i 'jog tshul yang don dam par gshis cir yang ma grub pa la blos cir yang mi 'dzin par rtog med kyi ngang la gsal sing nge bzhag go /gsum pa gnyug sems la brtan pa thob phyir gnas cha skyong tshul 'phros dang bcas te bshad pa la bzhi/ sems la gnas cha gsum dang myong ba rim par 'char tshul bshad pa dang*/ de la brten nas rtogs pa'i ngo bo 'char tshul bshad pa dang*/ gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi khyad par la dogs pa bcad pa dang*/ gang zag gsum la gnas pa rang nyams myong dang rtogs pa gsum 'char tshul gyi khyad par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i gnas cha chung 'bring chen po gsum gyi nyams rim par 'char te/ de yang dang po sems kyi gnas cha chung ngu la gnas pa dang po ni ri gzar gyi rbab dang 'dra ste/ rnam rtog thol gyis skyes pa na de ga'i ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas rang grol du song bas de ma thag dran zung rnam par rtog pa thol thol du skyes nas yun ring bas gnas mi nus pa ri gzar las rbab 'gril ba lta bu'o/ /rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjes/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems la tshur bltas pas/ /sems mi rtag shing kha'i byi'u 'dra/ / bzhag sar skad cig mi sdod bros pas na/

/sems nyid gzhi rtsa chod dam ras chung ba/ /zhes so/ /gnas pa dang po'i tshe rnam rtog gcig mjug gnyis mthud skye bas/ bsgoms pas rnam rtog mang du yong snyam yang*/ rnam rtog skyes byung tshad tshor ba de gnas cha cung zad rnyed pa yin/ sngar rtog pa rang dgar shor du rnam rtog 'gyus pa ngo ma shes te/ zhang rin po ches/ gnas pa dang po byung dus su/ / ri gzar logs las rbab 'gril bzhin/ /rnam rtog zam ma chad par ldang*/ / sgom nyams med dam snyam pa song*/ /rnam rtog byung tshad tshor ba de/ /shes pa cung zad gnas pa yin/ /gnas pa med pa'i gong rol tu/ /rnam rtog rang dgar shor ba yin/ /rtog pa byung yang ngo ma shes/ /zhes so/ /rnam rtog thol gyis byung yang lhod kyis glod/ rtsen gyis bzhag /de ltar yang yang byas pas sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de gcer gyis mthong bas rtog pa snga phyi'i mtshams su cung zad tsam ngo bo'i steng du gnas pa 'ong*/ de nas kyang dran shes kyis ma yengs par ngo bo bskyangs pas rnam rtog rags pa mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i rba rlabs rnams ngang gis zhi ste/ gnas pa bar pa chu bo gaṅgā dal gyis 'bab pa lta bu'i sems gnas byung ste/ bla ma zhang gis/ de nas dal 'bab chu bo bzhin/ /shes pa dal zhing rnam rtog nyung*/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe ngo bo'i steng nas 'phro nas gang shar kyang gang shar gzhi med rtsa bral du lhang lhang mi 'char bar du dran pa yengs med du brtan pas gnyug ma'i ngo bo lhag gis mthong ba yin te/ rje mai tri pas/ sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod par/ /shes pa gang dgar mi btang 'tshal/ /zhes dang*/ mar pas/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo skad cig ma/ /cig car ba la phri bsnan med/ /rang grol gnyug ma'i bde ba che/ /re dogs bral ba 'bras bu lags/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ sems mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i rnam rtog 'di/ / skyes kyang skye med gzhi rtsa bral/ /dran pa yengs med yid ches dgos/

blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung ba/ /zhes dang*/ mnyam med yang dgon pas/ blo ngan goms kyi bag chags shog dril 'dra/ /nyams gsar bur skyes kyang rkyen gyis 'jig /dus yun thung gis 'khrul ba mi chod pas/ /sgom yun du srings dang skal ldan kun/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bskyangs pas rnam rtog rags pa cher mi 'byung ba'i lus sems bde mo re la gnas pa la thun 'khyongs pa byung ba'i tshe/ zhang rin po ches/ mtha' ma rgya mtsho'i gting bzhin du/ /shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /zhes gnas par bsam/ mtha' ma rgya mtsho mi 'gul srin bu 'gul/ /zhes grags pa de yin pas/ de 'dra'i bde ba la zhen par mi bya ste/ rje btsun gyis/ zag bcas bde ba'i rba klong du/ /rnam rtog rags pa nub pa yi/ /bde ba'i ro myang mi bgyid 'tshal/ /zhes dang*/ rtog med zhi gnas brtan pa na/ /dam pa nyid du mi bzung 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gnas pa skyong ba'i tshe thog mar gnas cha 'tshol ba'i tshe bying rmugs dang 'phro rgod kyis bar gcod na de'i gnyen po sgom tshul ni/ u rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ bying ba la rig pa ngar bskyed hur bton/ nam mkha' ltar rgya bskyed la bsgom/ rgod pa la rig pa 'phangs dmod/ mi rtag 'khor ba'i duḥkha blo ldog bsgom/ 'phros na 'phro ba'i rang ngo lta zhing dmigs rten la bsgrims te bsgom/ rmugs na bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ rig pa gzengs bstod/ shes pa dga' ba'i thabs byas la bsgoms/ 'byams na grim gyis bsgrims/ hril gyis bsdus/ mig sna rtser phab ste rang ngo la gcer gyis bltas pas sel lo zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang sems 'di las 'dzin stangs lhod na bying ba skye ba 'dug snyam pa la rig pa ngar bskyed/ 'di las grim na sems gzhan du 'phro ba'am rgod pa skye ba 'dug snyam pa las/ mi sgrim par grim lhod ran pa myong ba la brtags nas ngo bo skyong tshul shes par bya'o/

/bying rgod thug phrad lam 'khyer gyis sel tshul ni/ u rgyan rin po ches/ bying rgod skyon du ma lta blo gtad gyis/ /zhes dang*/ dam pa rin po ches/ bying na phaṭa kyis gseng ba yin/ /'phros na rtsa ba gcod pa yin/ / rgod na dbyings su 'jog pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjes/ blo rgod tsa na lta bas thog brdzis thob/ /sems mtshan ma rang grol 'di ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /yang na yang dgon pas/ bying rmugs 'thibs tshe dpral ba'i dbyings/ / rgod na lte 'og rtsa gsum steng*/ /zhes gnas de gnyis su bying rgod kyi tshe bla ma bsgom par gsungs pa ltar bya la/ de'i rigs pas/ gnas der bla ma'i ngo bo thig le bsgoms kyang legs so/ /rje 'brom gyis/ 'tshub sar shes pa glod dang dge ba yin/ /zhes pas kyang 'phro rgod kyi gnyen po bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa de la brten nas rtogs pa'i ngo bo 'char tshul bshad pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas bying rgod dang bral ba de tshe sems byings po dmigs pa la gnas kyang*/ rnam rtog phra mo 'gyu ba na/ gnyen pos bcos bslad kyang mi bya/ rnam rtog la skyon du'ang mi lta bar rtogs pa kho rang rang babs su lhug par bzhag pas gnyug ma'i ngo bo ma bcos pa bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i 'od gsal rjen par lhag gis 'char te/ de ltar nyams su myong bas mthong ba de la ni sems kyi ngo bo mthong ba zhes kyang zer/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo 'phrod pa'ang zer/ gzhi'i 'od gsal chos sku nyams su myong ba'ang zer te/ tai lo pas/ kye ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te/ /ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min/ /tai lo ngas ni ci yang bstan du med/ /rang gis rang nyid mtshon pa shes par gyis/ /zhes dang*/ rje rgod tshang pas/ skye bo tsa na'i shes pa 'di/ /chos kyi sku ru 'dug pa la/ /bla mas bstan kyang mi dgos par/

/rang gis shes su gsha' ba la/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ rtog pa snga phyi'i so mtshams na/ /ye shes rgyun du 'char te brod/ /ces dang*/ gnas lugs mdzod las/ gang ltar 'gyus pa rang bab lhug par zhog /'gyu 'phro'i thog nas chos nyid dgongs pa gsal/ /zhes dang*/ gling ras pas/ rje'i zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ /sgoms shig gsungs pas bsgoms lags kyang*/ /bsgom bya dang sgom byed stor te thal/ /sgom thun mtshams su bcad du mi gda' ye/ /zhes so/ /de ltar ngo 'phrod nas/ rje mar pas/ nang 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam shes 'di/ /sngon chad mdza' bo phrad pa bzhin/ /sems nyid rang ngo rang gis shes/ /lkugs pas rmi lam rmis pa bzhin/ /brjod du med pa'i nyams shig shar/ /gzhon nus bde ba myong ba bzhin/ /smra ru med pa'i don cig rtogs/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin no/ / gsum pa gnas 'gyu rig gsum gyi khyad par la dogs pa gcod pa ni/ de dag gi tshe 'gyu ba phra rags sbom gsum 'byung ba'i khyad par ni dper na dge sbyor byed blo'i ngang nas skom 'thung snyam pa 'gyu ba phra mo dang*/ dge sbyor byed blo tsam yang brjed nas skom 'thung snyam pa rags pa dang*/ lus ngag gis skom 'thung ba la dngos su zhugs pa 'gyu ba sbom po yin zhes bla ma sngon ma rnams gsungs so/ /de ltar na 'gyu ba gsum ga gnas pa dang po'i skabs kyi 'gyu ba las len dgos so/ kho bo ni/ 'gyu ba sbom po ni gnas pa dang po'i skabs su rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba zam ma chad pa lta bur ldang ba dang*/ 'gyu ba rags pa ni gnas pa gnyis pa'i skabs su sems dmigs pa la dal bar gnas pa'i tshe chu las nya 'phar ba ltar rnam rtog thol gyis 'gyu ba dang*/ 'gyu ba phra mo ni gnas pa rab kyi tshe sems ngo bo la rtse gcig gnas pa'i ngang nas/ rnge'u bzung nas rnga mo btang ba bzhin du rnam rtog phra mo 'gyus kyang sems kho rang rang mal du 'ong ba lta bu'o/

/'o na skabs 'dir sgom gnas thog nas 'gyu ba dang*/ 'gyu thog nas gnas sam mi gnas zhe na/ bdag gi bla ma mkhas pa kha cig de ltar mi srid gsungs/ 'o na de ltar mi srid pa de snying thig thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa yin nam/ 'on te phyag rdzogs thun mong ba'i dgongs pa yin/ dang po ltar na yang 'thad par dka' mod/ yin du chug kyang skabs don 'chol bar 'gyur te/ skabs 'dir chen po gsum ga'i dgongs pa thun mong ba lta ba spyi khyab tu ngo sprod pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ltar na'ang mi 'thad de/ sa ra has/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces dang*/ u rgyan rin po ches/ 'di ltar yid kyi yul du 'gyu ba yi/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang*/ /sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yi bcos mi gzhug /'gyu ba rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol/ /ces 'gyu thog nas gnas pa dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ bu lam rig pa ma tshugs sna tshogs pa/ /skyon yon ma lta thug phrad lam du khyer/ / zhes dang*/ hūṃ gi dgongs pa'i gnas las/ rang sems chos nyid klong chen ngang nyid las/ /rig pa skad cig rang las gtol skyes te/ /zhes gnas thog nas 'gyu bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na skabs 'dir rnam rtog chos skur bzhed pa dang*/ 'gyu thog na gnas pa mi srid par bzhed pa gnyis 'gal lam snyam ste zhib tu dpyad par bya'o/ /snying thig thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pa yang min te/ klong gsal las/ ye shes gsal ba'i yul drug las/ /gnyis 'dzin sems 'di 'byung ba'o/ /zhes gnas thog nas 'gyu ba dang*/ klong chen pas/ gang ltar 'gyus pa rang babs lhug par bzhag /'gyu 'phro'i steng nas chos nyid dgongs pa gsal/ /zhes 'gyu thog nas gnas par yang gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa gang zag gsum la/ gnas pa dang*/ nyams myong dang*/ rtogs pa gsum 'char tshul gyi khyad par bshad pa ni/

'o na gnas pa che 'bring chung gsum gyi skabs su/ gdul bya cig car ba dang*/ thod rgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pa gsum la nyams rtogs skye tshul gyi khyad par ji lta bu zhe na rim gyis pa la dang por gnas pa gsum/ de nas nyams myong*/ de nas rtogs pa lhag gi 'char te/ zhang rin po ches/ rim gyis pa yi 'char tshul ni/ /dang po gnas pa tsam du 'byung*/ /de nas nyams myong nges par 'char/ /de rjes rtogs pa lhag gi 'char/ /gnas pa dang po byung dus su/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa rnams kyi mjug tu/ mtha' ma rgya mtsho'i gting bzhin du/ /shes pa mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /de nas nyams su myong ba 'char/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil lta bur/ /gsal la mi rtog bde ba myong*/ /zhes dang por gnas pa gsum rim gyis 'byung*/ de rjes nyams su myong ba'i bde ba 'char bar gsungs so/ /rtogs pa'i 'char tshul ni/ de nyid kyis/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor pas/ /shes pa lhod kyis glod pa'i tshe/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ / bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char/ /de ltar shar ba'i dus nyid du/ /sdig sgrib dpag med nges par 'dzad/ /nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes kyang*/ /chos kyi sku dang mjal ba yin/ /gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /rtogs pa lhag gi shar ba'i tshe/ /skad cig nyid la thog med nas/ /bsags pa'i sdig pa ji snyed rnams/ /ma lus gtan nas 'joms par byed/ /ces so/ /thod rgal ba ni dang po rtogs pa byung yang mi brtan pas/ nyams rtogs gnas pa gsum la go rim nges pa med par 'char bas thod rgal ba zhes pa ste/ de nyid kyis/ thod rgal ba yi 'char lugs ni/ /gnas dang myong ba rtogs pa gsum/ /sngon du rtogs pa lhag gi 'char/ /rtogs kyang mi brtan rba rlabs 'dra// res 'ga' nyams myong res 'ga' ni/ /gnas pa 'ong ste nges pa med/ /nyams kyi mtho dman rig pa'i rtsal/ /zhes so/ /cig car ba la ni/ bla mas gdams ngag gi ngo sprod gnang ma thag gam/

de la brten nas sems kyi ngo bo la rjen cher gyi nyams myong dang rtogs pa gnas pa gsum sgom pa'i 'bad rtsol la ma bltos par gsum ga dus gcig tu 'char zhing*/ de'i 'char tshul ni/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong ba dang dus mnyam du ngo bo'i steng du rjen lhag gi gnas pa dang*/ de nyams su myong ba'i bde ba gsum cig car skye ste/ zhang rin po ches/ cig car ba yi gang zag la/ /rtogs pa'i bcud ldan bla ma yis/ /gdams ngag bstan ma thag pa'am/ /sems kyis bltas pa tsam gyis ni/ /nyams myong rtogs pa gnas pa gsum/ /sgom long med par dus gcig 'char/ /nyams myong 'phel 'grib byung gyur kyang*/ /rtogs pa 'gyur med brtan par gnas/ /spra spre yar brgyugs mar brgyugs kyang*/ /ljon shing 'gyur ba med par gnas/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ngo 'phrod nas don de nyams su len tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ don de mnyam rjes gnyis su nyams su len pa'i tshul bshad pa dang*/ de dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la rjes shes rngas ma lta bu dang*/ mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bu la rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i khyad par ni/ bye tshang pa rin chen dpal 'byor gyis/ phyi na yul gyi ched 'dzin med/ /nang du rig pa gsal la dwangs/ /rig pa phyi nang zang thal 'di/ / mnyam bzhag yin no a ne ma/ /de las cung zad yengs pa na/ /yul gyi rjes su thal gyi 'gyus/ /gzung 'dzin bun gyis shar ba de/ /rjes shes yin no a ne ma/ /de nas dran pas cher gyis zin/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa rang zhi nas/ /jar gyi mnyam bzhag gsal thebs pa/ /rjes thob yin no a ne ma/ /zhes gsungs la/ zhal gdams lhug par rgyun du gnas pa la nyams zer/ de'i ngang nas dbang po tshogs drug gi yul snang la brten pa'i bzang rtog ngan rtog ci byung yang gang shar gyi rtog pa la bzo bcos dang spang blang ma byas par rang ngo la cher bltas/

rang sar glod nas bzhag pas rang grol du khrol gyi song na gang shar thams cad sgom gyi grogs su 'gro ba yin/ rjes shes lam du lhongs pa la rjes thob zer ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas sems la gnas cha rnyed pa na gnyug ma bsam brjod dang bral ba'i bde ba chen po'i ngang nas/ rtog pa gang shar kyang rjes su mi 'brang bar/ shes pa 'bol le shig ge rjen ne ye re mi rtog par ngo bo'i steng du rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa la 'di pa'i lugs kyi mnyam bzhag dang*/ gal te dran pa'i rgyang so shor nas rnam rtog thol gyis skyes par ma tshor bar de'i dbang du song ba la rjes shes rngas ma lta bu dang*/ rjes shes lam du ma longs pa zer/ mnyam bzhag de las langs rjes su/ tshogs drug gi yul du gang snang ba thams cad bde stong dbyer med kyi rol pa snang stong tshogs pa sgyu ma lta bur 'char zhing*/ de shar ba na yang nang du mnyam bzhag gi grogs su 'gyur ba la rjes shes lam du longs pa dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu zhes zer te/ rje mar pas/ phyi gzung ba yul gyi snang ba 'di/ /bde ba chen por rgyun chad med/ /skye med phyag rgya chen por rtogs/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*/ /ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste/ /yul gyi zhen pas 'ching bar byed/ /rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*/ /yul snang sems kyi grogs su 'char/ /mthar thug don la snang ma myong*/ /skye med chos skur dag go gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rjes shes rngas ma lta bu dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i khyad par zhes pa'i tha snyad grags chung yang*/ rjes shes lam du longs pa dang ma longs pa'i tha snyad ni yang dgon pa sogs/ phyag rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' la grags pas don 'dra'o/ /mnyam rjes kyi nyams len de yang hril gyi dril nas byed na/ rgyun du rtsa ba'i bla ma tur gyis dran te gsol ba 'debs/

rnam par rtog pa 'das pa'i rjes mi dpyad/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngun mi bsu bar/ da lta nyid rnam rtog ci 'dra/ cir 'gyu yin 'dug snyam du/ da ltar gyi rtog pa skad cig ma 'di nyid la gcer gyis bltas pas/ rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul rbad kyi chad nas/ ma yengs bar du rtog pa mi 'ong*/ nam yengs pa na rtog pa yer gyi 'ong ste/ byung ba'i rtog pa de nyid la gcer gyis bltas pas mi rtag par phyam phyam 'gro /de ltar rtog pa gang byung byung la 'dod thog tu bya zhing gcer gcer ba blta'o/ /thun yun mi ring tsam nas gsal bdo ba 'phro bcad cing yun thung la grangs mang ba re bya'o/ /de ltar yang yang bltas pas/ dus tshod cig na rtog pa ngos chir gyi zin te grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam rtog ngos zin pa bya ba ni/ rnam rtog skye ba med pa/ 'gag pa med pa/ gnas pa med pa/ dngos po med pa/ ngos bzung med pa nam mkha' lta bur nges pa'i shes pa rjen lhang gi skyes pa'o/ /de'i tshe nyams rtogs gcig tu 'dres pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'di la dgongs nas sgam po zla 'od gzhon nus/ mtshan mar ma skyes rnam rtog 'di/ /chos sku yin pas chir gyis bzung*/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag tu nyams su len tshul dang*/ rje thob tu nyams su len tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ zhi gnas sgom tshul dang*/ lhag mthong sgom tshul lo/ /dang po zhi gnas sgo tshul la gnyis/ sems bag la nyal du mi bzhag par reg pa lnga grung 'don pa'i phyir du dran shes bsten tshul/ 'bad rtsol gyi 'ching byed med par gnas pa'i phyir du rang sar glod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ sems dar cig kyang ma yengs par/ sems kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa bzhin du/ grim gyis bsgrims te bzhag nas/ cung zad kyang ma 'gyus par bzhag go /de la thun 'khyongs pa byung na/ skabs skabs su cung zad glod pa'i 'bor len byed pa'i dran pa'i 'dzin stangs ma shor bar bya ste/

yang dgon pas/ bu gcig shi ba'i ma bzhin du/ /'bral med brjed med yengs med du/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skad cig kyang ma yengs par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i dran pa ma yengs par yod na/ cung zad yengs pa'am yengs pa'i grab byed tsam nas rig pa'i shes bzhin 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dran pa yid sgo nas/ /bsrung ba'i don du gnas gyur pa/ /de tshe shes bzhin 'ong 'gyur zhing/ /

zhes sogs dang*/ rnal 'byor drug pa las/ shes bzhin dran dang mtshungs ldan du/ /bying rgod nyes pa byung ma byung*/ /phra mo rtog pa'i shes rab ste/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa ra has/ bram ze skud pa 'khal ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor shes pa glod la zhog /ces sems kho rang rang sar phyam me/ lhod de/ shig ge ba la ma yengs tsam ma brjed tsam du skyong ba yin te/ zhang rin po ches/ gzings las 'phur ba'i bya rog bzhin/ /yul la 'phros pa'i sems mi bsdus/ /mar me rlung gis mi skyod bzhin/ /gsal la mi rtog ma yengs zhog / nags la me lce mched pa bzhin/ /cir snang phyag rgya chen por zhog /rgya mtshor snang ba'i gza' skar bzhin/ /snang srid phyag rgya chen por zhog /mkhas pa ba lang skyong ba bzhin/ /rnal 'byor shes pa gang bder thong*/ /zhes pa ltar ma yengs pa'i ngang nas glod pas thun tshad la phebs pa dang*/ yang gsal btab la bsgom par bya ste/ u rgyan rin po ches/ sgom la ma zhen yang dang yang du shig / ces dang*/ bzang rtog ngan rtog gang shar gcer te ltos/ /yun thung grangs mang khang stong thigs pa bzhin/ /lus sems ma sgrim lhod de shig ge zhog /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de thams cad la dri ba zhib tu byas la/ sgom shes ma shes dang*/ skye tshul ji ltar byung dri bar bya'o/ /de'i tshe lus gnad 'khrul 'khor bcas/ sems sgom thog tu bzhag tsa na/ rtog pa rang sar zhi la khag 'gag /rang sar zhi nas sems rang babs su rtog med du lhod de rtse gcig tu gnas pa la 'di pa'i lugs kyi sgom skyes zer ba lags so/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong sgom tshul la gnyis/ gnas lugs kyi rang zhal bstan te chos sku gcer mthong du ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'gyu thog tu rang ngo sprad de shar grol dus mnyam du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgom pa por mi dmigs te/ sgom bya'o snyam pa'i 'dzin pa yang med par bya/ bsgom byar yang mi dmigs te/ bde gsal mi rtog sogs gang du yang yid la mi sgom/

gang yang yid la mi byed par/ sems kho rang rang babs su rang sar bzhag pa la ma yengs par bya/ bying ba ma yin te rig pa ngar skyed hur te bsgom/ rgod pa ma yin te 'das ma 'ongs gang gi yang rtog pa yid la mi bya bar mnyam par bzhag go /gsal ba thun 'khyongs pa'i tshe 'phro bcad la bsgom/ de ltar rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas snang srid kyi chos thams cad rang la rang phar so ma shor/ mdog ma bsgyur bar/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po/ gshis ci yang ma yin pa la mdangs cir yang ma 'gags pa yul med du rang gsal ba'i da ltar gyi shes pa ngo bo rjen lhag gi shar ba la rtogs pa skyes pa zhes kyang bya/ 'dir bstan lhag mthong gi myu gu 'khrungs pa zhes kyang bya/ gnyug sems mngon sum du mthong ba zhes kyang bya'o/ /de skad du yang*/ 'das rjes las/ yin pa grub pa med pa'i rig pa 'di/ /rang snang 'char tshul cir yang ma 'gags pa/ /snang srid kun kyang chos sku'i zhing du shar/ /shar ba de nyid rang gi thog tu grol/ /ces dang*/ klong drug pa las/ brjod du med pa'i sems nyid la/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong rang shar bas// mnyam par bzhag dang rjes su ni/ /mi g.yo bsam gtan nyid du rdzogs/ /zhes so/ /rje dwags po lha rjes kyang*/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa la dang por rtsol sgrub dang bral bar lus sems khong glod pa dang*/ bar du the tshom med pas sems ma bcos pa so mar bzhag pa dang*/ mtha' ma byung tshor thams cad skye med du shes par bya'o gsungs/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong na/ de ji lta bu zhe na/ rje dwags po lha rje'i zhal nas/ gnyug ma zhes pa'i don ci la zer na/ rten gang la yang ma bcas pa/ go gar yang ma 'gags pa/ phyogs gang yang ma lhung ba/ phugs gar yang ma gtad pa/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa brjod pa gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs pa la zer ba yin gsungs/

de'i don ni/ de la dang po rten gang la mi bca' ba ni shes pa ci la yang mi brten pa ste dper na bya thi bo ni bzhin yin/ go gar yang ma 'gags pa ni re dogs dgag sgrub gang yang med pa yin/ phyogs gar yang ma lhung ba ni/ rtag chad kyi mthar ma lhung ba'o/ /phugs gar yang ma gtad pa ni 'dod pa med pa'o// dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa ni ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'o/ / brjod pa gang gis kyang thog tu mi phebs pa ni/ brjod pa thams cad las 'das pa yin no gsungs/ de lta bu'i gnyug sems kyang bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje'i gzigs pa zhugs pa'i byin rlabs 'ba' zhig gis rtogs dgos pa yin te/ kyai rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs brten pa dang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ bla ma chos kyi spyan ldan rtogs pa dang ldan pa chos rgyud la skyes pa zhig la/ slob mas dad gus tshul bzhin byas na rtogs nas 'ong ba yin no/ /bla ma la rtogs pa med na slob mas dad gus byas kyang mi phan/ dper na sgaur phor la ri mo med na 'bi 'bi legs kyang sa tshwa mi 'byung ba dang 'dra gsungs/ slob ma la dad gus med na bla ma la gdams ngag yod kyang mi phan te/ dper na ba la zho yod kyang be'u la rkan med pa dang 'dra gsungs/ 'di dag gi skabs su yang sngar bshad pa'i sems 'tshol gyi man ngag rnams bar bar du nyams su blang ngo*/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i gnas skabs kun tu yang tshe la long med kyi mi rtag pa dran pa/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches kyi dad pa/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gsum la goms pa dang ma bral ba dgos te/ rje dwags po lha rje'i zhal nas/ des na lam rim gtsigs su che/ de rnams rgyud la mi ldan na gnyug ma rab rib cig rgyud la skyes kyang yul dang nye du dang rdzas dang longs spyod la chags nas gnyug ma des mi phan/

mar 'gro ba las yar mi 'gro /de bas na tshe 'di la chags par ma byed/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yin pas blo nges su chug /byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sbyongs/ de ltar nges na kho yar la 'gro ba las mar la mi 'gro gsungs/ rje btsun gyis/ nga 'chi ba kho nas 'jigs 'jigs nas/ /'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang la sbyangs/ / zhes dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa gsha' ma zhig dran na/ dang por blo chos su 'gro bar byed/ bar du chos lam du 'gro bar byed/ mtha' mar 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po thob par byed pa yin no zhes dang*/ bla ma zhang gis kyang*/ byams pa snying rje byang chub sems mchog la/ /lam gyi gtso bor bgyis nas bslabs lags pas/ /bogs la thug pa ma mchis phyi nas ni/ / spros bral de nyid snying rje chen por shar/ /rang bzhin gzhi med spros bral nam mkha' la/ /bden 'dzin grol bas zhe 'dod mkhan po grol/ /ces so/ /de dag gi gnas lugs kyi rang zhal bstan nas/ skabs su dri bas mtha' bcad de dred po go yul du lus pa rnams rdar sha chod pa'i ngo 'phrod nges bya'o/ /gnyis pa la 'gyu thog tu ngo sprad de shar grol dus mnyam du bstan pa ni/ sngar bzhin gnyug sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo ma yengs par bskyangs pas/ sems las rnam rtog sna tshogs par 'phro ba dang mi 'phro bar gnas pa'i dus gnyis ka la ngo bo la bzang ngan la sogs pa'i khyad par gang yang med de/ rnam rtog ji snyed 'gyus kyang ngo bo sems las 'das pa med/ dper na nam mkha' la sprin la sogs pa ji snyed byung yang byung ba'i tshe yang nam mkha' las byung la/ yal ba'i tshe yang nam mkha'i klong du yal/ gnas pa'i tshe yang nam mkha'i klong du gnas pa bzhin du rnam rtog 'phro ba'i tshe yang sems las 'phro/ yal ba'i tshe yang sems su yal/ gnas pa'i tshe yang sems su gnas la/ rnam rtog de'i ngo bo nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil bzhin du rnal 'byor pa rang gis nyams su myong ba ji bzhin du brjod du med pa'o/

/de skad du/ klong chen pas/ 'phro na 'phro mkhan rang gi sems/ kha dog dbyibs bral ngos bzung med/ /gnas na gnas mkhan rang gi sems/ /ye grol gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid/ /blang dor re dogs rtsis gdab med/ /ye stong rtsa bral chen por bzhag / ces gsungs so/ /de nas stong zhing bdag med pa'i sems kyi ngo bo 'di rkyen phyin ci log la goms pa'i bag chags ngan pa'i dbang gis bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog gi rnam par shar ba'i tshe yang sems yin/ shar ba'i ngo bo la bltas pas rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas stong par song ba'i tshe yang sems yin/ gang du 'phro ji ltar 'gyu yang ngo bo sems las gzhan min pas gang shar rjes med blo 'das su ngo sprod/ de skad du yang rje btsun gyis/ khyed sems nyid sgom du bde lags na/ /rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /byung yang sems nyid rang las byung*/ /thim yang sems nyid rang la thim/ /sems nyid rang gi ngang du zhog /ces dang*/ sems la rnam rtog 'dug pa na/ /rang sems dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs/ /'khor 'das gnyis su ma 'dzin par/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du zhog /gang shar rjes med ngang du skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ snang ba sems su bstan pa dang*/ rnam rtog chos skur ngo sprad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mnyam bzhag tu sgro 'dogs chod pa'i nges shes skyes pa na rjes thob tu 'khor 'das kyi chos gang snang dang*/ khyad par gzugs sgra la sogs phyi rol gyi snang ba gang snang yang ltos med tshugs thub tu ling nge snang yang*/ gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i bag chags kyi snang ba ma gtogs pa/ bden par grub pa rdul tsam yang med pas gang snang gi thog tu lhod glod nas bzhag pa'i tshe snang stong dbyer med du rjen lhag gi shar ba la snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan can zhes pa'am/ snang ba rgya yan du bskyang ba zhes bya ba dang*/ snang ba sems su ngo sprad pa zhes bya ste/

snang ba stong par ngo sprad pa dang*/ snang ba sems su ngo sprad pa dgongs pa gcig pa'i phyir/ tai lo pas/ snang bas mi 'ching zhen pas 'ching*/ /zhen pa chod cig nā ro pa/ /zhes dang*/ phyi yi yul la lhod kyi glod pas/ /snang ba chos sku'i rgya yan 'di shes/ /zhes dang*/ rgod tshang pas/ snang ba rgya yan du bskyang ba zhes so/ /dper na mi gcig la lta mkhan gyi dbang gis sdug mi sdug bar ma sogs snang yang mi gcig yin par mi 'gal ba bzhin du/ snang ba 'di dag sna tshogs par snang yang don rang bzhin skye ba med par mnyam pa nyid de/ mdor na gang snang thams cad stong pa/ stong pa bde bar shar bas bde stong dbyer med kyi rol par cham cham blta bar bya ste/ sa ra has/ ji ltar rlung gis bskyod pas mi g.yo ba'i/ /chu yang g.yo ba'i rba rlabs rnams su 'gyur/ /de ltar rgyal po mda' bsnun snang ba yang*/ /gcig nyid na yang rnam pa sna tshogs byed/ /ji ltar rmongs pas logs nas bltas pa yis/ /mar me gcig nyid gnyis su snang bar 'gyur/ /de ltar blta bya lta byed gnyis med la/ /kye ma blo ni gnyis kyi dngos por snang*/ /zhes chos thams cad gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du gsungs so/ /des na snang ba rang sems zhes pa snang ba thams cad sems sam blos btags nas bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs/ bden par grub pa med ces pa yin gyi/ sems tsam pa dang mtshungs pa'i don med do/ /gnyis pa rnam rtog chos skur ngo sprad pa la/ gzhi dus kyi rnam rtog chos sku rtogs rung chos sku ma rtogs rung chos sku/ dper na dbul po'i nang gi gter bzhin/ lam dus kyi rnam rtog chos sku/ thol gyi skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'di/ chos sku yin pas chir gyis zungs/ 'bras dus kyi rnam rtog chos sku gser gling du rdo mi rnyed pa lta bu gsungs pa ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/

/de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas te/ /zhes sems can gyi rgyud kyi gnyug sems sangs rgyas chos kyi skur bsgrub gzhir gsungs pa dang*/ do ha las/ gnyug ma'i rang bzhin byis pas ma mthong bar/ /'khrul bas byis pa bslus zhes mda' bsnun smra/ /zhes gnyug sems tha mal gyi shes par ngo ma 'phrod pas byis pa so skye rnams 'khrul bar gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'gro kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /rang dbang du ni 'byung ma yin/ /de yi rgyu ni 'od gsal ba/ / 'od gsal thams cad stong pa'o/ /zhes 'chi ba'i 'od gsal gnyug sems su gsungs pa dang*/ de'i 'phro las/ sems gang gis ni byis pa rnams/ /'khor ba'i 'ching bas bcings gyur pa/ /sems de nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /bde gshegs gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes 'chi ba'i 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i gnyug sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang ngo ma shes pas byis pa so skye rnams 'khor bar 'khor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pas don de dpe dang don gyi 'od gsal gyi ngo bor bskyed nas sangs rgyas sgrub par gsungs pas/ gzhi la sems can gyi gnyug sems ma bcos pa 'di ngo bo rnam par rtog pa las ma 'das kyang*/ rnal 'byor pas ngo 'phrod kyang rung*/ ma 'phrod kyang rung*/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i bsgrub gzhir sems can rang rang la rang chas su yod pa yin te/ dper na dbul po'i nang gi rin po che'i gter de dbul po rang gis rin po che'i gter du ngo ma shes te/ dbul dus su yang rin po che yin la/ shes nas dbul ba sel dus su yang rin po che las ma 'das pa ltar ro/ /de skad du yang rje btsun mi las/ 'bras bu yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems las gzhan du 'bras bu btsal ba na/ /des rang sems spangs pa 'dra'o ang gi lha rje ston pa/ /zhes dang*/ mda' kha ye shes las/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o zhes so/

/'di dag gi tshul rgyas pa ni rgyud bla rtsa 'grel las bshad do/ /skabs 'dir rgyal po rkang 'khyam gyi dpe'i sgo nas ngo sprad pa yang yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ jo bo gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ rgyang gi gyur la lhod kyi glod/ /log ste log la gcer te ltos/ /shig ge shig la 'bol le zhog /des na mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ rnam rtog chos skur ma shar na/ /dran snang skad cig ga la langs/ /zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor mi la ras pa ngas/ /gcer gyis bltas pas ngo bo mthong*/ /spros bral nam mkha'i dkyil ltar mthong*/ /cog gi bzhag pas gnas lugs rtogs/ /dngos kun stong pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /lhod kyi glod pas rang sa zin/ /rig pa'i chu bo dwangs snyigs phyed/ /lings kyi bor bas dran rtog chad/ /'gro drug g.yang sa rbad kyi chod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar rang sems la rnam par rtog pa gang shar gyi ngo bo la blta/ nya ra mi byed rang sar glod pas mtshan ma thams cad rang sar zhi nas rig pa gsal stong rjen pa nam mkha' dag pa'i dkyil ltar shar ba la rnam rtog chos skur shar ba zhes bya ba yin no/ /de skad du glegs bam rin po che las/ gnyen po'i nang na gang mchog pa/

/spang bya thug phrad byed pa yin/ /spang bya thug phrad gang byed pa/ /skyes tsam nyid nas 'joms pa yin/ /zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ shes pa lhod kyi glod pa'i tshe/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i nyams/ /bar snang dag pa'i dkyil ltar 'char/ /de ni 'od gsal chos sku yin/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la/ /'di bya'i tig po mi bdog gis/ /nam dran dus su glod la zhog /ces so/ /mdor na rnam par rtog pa bzang ngan sna tshogs pa zhig rkyen dbang gis thol thol skye bas na/ skyes thog tu bzo bcos ma byed par rang babs su lhod glod nas bzhag /ma yengs par bzo bcos dang bral bar bzhag /gu yangs su phyam gyis skyur/ lings kyis bor nas bzhag pas/ dran rtog thams cad rang shar rang grol sbrul la mdud pa brgyab pa'am/ chu la ri mo bris pa bzhin du/ shar grol dus mnyam du bskyang bar bya ste/ sha ba ri pas/ rang gi de nyid rang gis rtogs gyur na/ /yengs pa'i sems kyang phyag rgya chen por 'char/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de tshe tshogs drug gi yul du sdug mi sdug gi snang ba shar ba sogs kyi rnam rtog gang skyes rang ngo shes pas gang shar lam du 'gro ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa skye med du rtogs pas de'i gzhan dbang du gyur nas las mi gsog pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba'i nyams len la rang dbang thob pas rjes shes kyi ngor kun rdzob kyi snang ba gang shar yang ltos med tshugs thub tu grub par snang yang snang tsam nyid nas bden pas stong pa rdzun pa sgyu ma lta bu/ zla grogs g.yo sgyu can gyis bslus pa ngo shes pa mthong ba ltar/ snang yang zhen pa med pa/ byed spyod thams cad rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ stong yang snang cha ma 'gags pa lus snang stong lha skur khrong khrong*/ ngag grag stong bzlas rjod du shar shar/ sems gsal stong 'dzin med stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug tu gnas pa las skad cig kyang yengs su med par bskyang bar bya ste/

rje 'jig rten mgon pos/ nang bde chen ting 'dzin mi brtan par/ /phyi lus ngag yid gsum rnam par g.yeng*/ /gzhan rgyud byin gyis mi rlobs pas/ /sgom gsal chab la mi dbo zhu/ /zhes rje spyan snga ba la gdams pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa de dang 'brel ba'i gdams pa bshad pa la gnyis/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi rnam bzhag dang*/ lta sgom spyod gsum gyi lam khyad bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po zhes pa ni snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas ngo bos grub par yod ma myong yang*/ tha snyad du rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa'i stong nyid rten 'brel ngo bo dbyer med du gnas pa'o/ /lam phyag rgya chen po zhes pa ni/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po la sgro 'dogs chod nas/ gzhi dang rjes su mthun par/ thabs shes zung 'brel du nyams len skyong ba'o/ /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po zhes pa ni/ lam gyis spangs rtogs rnams yongs su rdzogs pa sku gsum mngon du gyur pa'o/ /de dag la phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don 'jug tshul ni/ chos thams cad kyi gshis 'di las mi 'da' bas na phyag rgya/ 'di las khyad par du byas pa'i gnas lugs bla'am gong na med pas na chen po zhes bya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa yang 'dir ma 'dus pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ de la rtsal sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po la myong ba'am rtogs pas sgro 'dogs chod pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang la yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis rtsad rdar legs par bcad pa na/ don la ngo bos grub pa'i chos cung zad tsam yang yid la byas pa med par rtogs pa'i ye shes sam shes rab la lta ba phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ste/ brtag gnyis las/ ngo bos gzugs med mthong ba'o/ /sgra med thos pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/ /ro med myong ba po yang med/ /reg med reg pa po yang med/

/ces sogs gsungs so/ /de la gzugs med nas reg med kyi bar gyis chos kyi bdag med dang*/ mthong ba po med nas reg pa po med kyi bar gyis gang zag gi bdag med bstan/ ngo bos zhes pas de gnyis la med rgyu'i bdag ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa la byed par bstan to/ /sdud pa las kyang*/ gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos/ /shes rab kyis ni bshig na rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ /'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro /zhes chos rnams rang gi ngo bos ma grub par rtogs pa'i tshe sher phyin gyi mdo'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi don rtogs par gsungs pa dang*/ tai lo pas kyang/ blo 'das byar med don 'di thob 'dod na/ / rang sems rtsod chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /ces dang*/ rje btsun mi las kyang*/ lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gdeng*/ /zhes dang*/ don dam bden pa'i dbang du ni/ /bgegs las sangs rgyas nyid kyang med/ /ces sogs gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i lta ba gtso bor skyong ba'i rnal 'byor pa la rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras gsum du ngo sprad na/ gang shar gyi rig pa skad cig ma gshis sprod pa dang bral ba gzhi/ de rang ngo shes pa lta ba/ de thog tu bzhag pa sgom pa/ de ltar 'bral med lam du byed pa spyod pa ste/ jo bo rjes/ chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ /shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag /ces so/ /de rnams mngon du gyur pa la 'bras bu'o zhes ngo sprad par bya'o/ /de skad du yang rje btsun gyis/ gzhi ma bcos khyab brdal chen por shar/ /lam ma bcos zang thal chen por shar/ /'bras bu ma bcos phyag rgya cher por shar/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa sgom pa phyag rgya chen po ni lta ba phyag rgya chen pos sems kyi gshis lugs myong thog tu sgro 'dogs chod pa la gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo sprad de mnyam bzhag tu sgom pa'o/ /spyod pa phyag rgya chen po ni/

lta sgom gyi gdeng dang ma bral ba nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa rab 'bring tha gsum gang yin dang rjes su mthun pa'i sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya la slob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar lta sgom spyod gsum nyams su blangs pas sems bskyed kyi don la brtan pa thob nas 'gag med du rtsal sbyong ba la gnyis/ las dang po pa'i skabs su cha mthun nyams su len tshul dang*/ lam gong mar dngos su sbyong tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems stong nyid du rang ngo shes nas rnam par rtog pa dang snang ba thams cad 'gag med du shar yang*/ shar tsam nas mtshan ma rang sar grol ba'i stong nyid du 'char ba lta bu'i myong ba sna zin skyes pa'i tshe de thog tu bogs 'don byed pa yin no/ /'di ni blo rno ba la rtse gcig chung ngu ma skyes gong nas kyang 'byung bar gsungs pas nan tan gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsal sbyong ba dang*/ 'byongs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ spros bral gyi skabs su chos thams cad spros bral stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs na yang*/ rjes thob tu mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags shas che bas/ snang thog tu stong phyogs kyi dran pa shas cher bsten dgos par gsungs shing*/ mnyam bzhag gi lta ba'i rtsis dngos su ma zin pa'i rjes shes kyang 'byung bar gsungs pas skabs 'dir gang snang skye med du dran pa'i sgo nas/ rjes thob sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad ltar bslabs nas rtsal sbyong ba yin te/ jo bo rje'i zhal nas/ mnyam bzhag langs pa'i dus dag tu/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lta bur ni/ /chos kun lta ba goms byas pas/ /rjes kyi lta ba skyong ba dang*/ /thabs la slob pa gtso bor bya/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ rjes thob dus gsum rtog pa'i 'dul spyod 'di/ / dran snang thams cad chos skur ma shar bar/ /med thabs med do dgos dus dran par gyis/ /'khrul rtog yan par ma btang ma ṇi ba/

/zhes dang*/ rje btsun gyis/ sems skye med kyi ngang nas 'gag med 'phyo/ /skye 'gag gi mtshan ma rang sar zhi/ /lta ba'i thag chod blo re bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsal sbyang ngo*/ /gnyis pa 'byongs pa ni/ ro gcig gi skabs su gang snang skye med kyi dran pa brten mi dgos par snang ba gang shar gyi snang thog tu rang bzhin stong nyid du 'char bas snang ba gra ma nyams par snang stong zung 'jug tu 'char ba na rtsal 'byongs pa yin no/ /gsum pa nyams su blangs pas nyams rtogs dang sa lam gyi rim pa skye tshul bshad pa la bzhi/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ spros bral gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ ro gcig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ sgom med kyi rnal 'byor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar bstan pa'i nyams len thams cad rnal 'byor bzhi'i khongs su 'dus te/ rnal 'byor bzhis ni lam lnga kha bsdus pas so/ / des na dang po rnam rtog thol gyi skyes pa na/ bzo bcos ma byas par lhod kyi glod pas rang gi rig pa 'di rnam rtog gi ma bskyod par ci yang ma bcos/ gang yang mi sems par bzhag pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po yin pas nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa'i tshe gcig gi rnal 'byor ma nor bar skyes pa yin gsungs te/ 'di dus su sgom 'dun pa'i rtsol dran la rag las pas/ gnas na gnas pa'i ngo bo zhen med du bskyang*/ 'gyus ma 'gyus pa'i thog tu rang sar glod pas gnas thog tu 'gyu ba'i rang ngo shes/ 'gyu thog tu gnas pa'i rang so tshugs pas gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba de rtse gcig gi rang ngo 'phrod pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir gnas thog nas 'gyu mi 'gyu sogs sngar bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas sems gsal stong la blo 'byongs pas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi rnam sprul yin te/ sems nyid skye ba med par rtsad chod nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sar dag nas spros bral mngon sum du nges pa'i shes pa lhang gi skyes pa'i tshe sgom spros bral gyi rnal 'byor ma nor bar skyes pas 'khrul grol gyi bar lag 'gyel ba zhes bya ba yin no/

/'di'i rjes su mtshan 'dzin gyi bag chags kyi snang ba byung tshe/ gang snang gshis skye med stong pa nyid du 'char ba'i chos nyid gnyug ma gshis kyi ngo bo dran pa'i gnyug ma rang dran zhes pa'i dran pa dgos so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas sems kyi snang ba rig pa'i rtsal rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'gyus kyang gnyen po gzhan bsten mi dgos par/ sems kyi rnam rtog nyid la bden pa dang rtag par ma grub pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes te/ chos nyid mngon sum du nges zin gyi rgyun goms pas ting nge 'dzin gyi rjes dran shar te/ gang snang ye shes kyi rol pa 'ba' zhig tu shar te snang ba dgag mi dgos/ stong pa sgrub mi dgos par/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi mtshan ma rang sar grol nas 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi snang ba thams cad snang stong dbyer med stong pa nyid gcig nyid chos can sna tshogs pa snang bar shes nas gang shar kyi snang ba gra ma nyams par sgom du khyer bas snang stong zung 'jug rgyun du shar ba las snang sems kyi bar lag 'gyel bas ro gcig gi rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ zhar la lam gyi thob skal rtsi tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas sems kyi rnam rtog dang*/ sgom pa'i nyams dang*/ rtogs pa'i shes rab rnams/ ngo bo mngon sum du mthong zin bsgoms pa'i mthus dbyings su yal te tha mal gyi shes pa ma bcos pa chos nyid du ngos 'dzin pa/ nges pa'i shes pa lhang gi skyes pas dran 'dun rtsol ba'i cha dbyings su dag nas rtsol med yang dag gi mkhyen dran shar te/ ngo bo ni rang rig ye shes/ rnam pa ni cir yang 'char ba/ gnas lugs bcos min gyi ngo bo bsgom bya sgom byed sogs gnyis snang gi blo'i cha thams cad las 'das pa'i blo bral gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa na/ sgom med kyi rnal 'byor rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /de yang mnyam bzhag tu snying rje mngon du gyur/

rjes thob tu chos nyid las mi 'da' ba'i yang dag gi mkhyen dran shar nas mnyam rjes kyi bar lag 'gyel ba na sgom mthar thug gi 'bras bu thob pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni rnal 'byor bzhi dang lam lnga'am/ sa bcu la sbyor tshul la mi mthun pa mang yang*/ rang lugs rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor sbyor lam man chad kyi mos spyod kyi sa la 'jog pa yin te/ rje gtsang ba rgya ras kyis/ rtse gcig nyams kyi snang ba yin/ /'jig rten lam ste las rnams gsog /ces so/ /skabs 'dir sems bde gsal mi rtog par yid ches kyi nges shes ma skyes na lhag mthong gi nyams dang mi 'dre bas/ rtse gcig mun pa'i khyim na 'byams/ /zhes 'khor sa gcig tu byed pas/ rje mi las/ rtogs pa rang shar yongs kyang 'tshal/ /rtogs pa rang shar ma byung na/ /so sor rtog dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ / zhes gsungs pa lta ba so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis gnas lugs myong thog tu sgro 'dogs legs par bcad de/ mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gis bzung ba ltar yid la byar med pa'i don yin lugs kyi steng du rtse gcig tu bzhag nas bsgom par bya ste/ rje btsun gyis/ bdag phyag rgya chen po sgom tsa na/ /don yin lugs kyi steng du rtse gcig bzhag /ma yengs pa'i ngang du glod nas bzhag /ces so/ /de'i rjes su spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byed pas 'di mthong lam kho nar 'jog pa dang*/ sa bdun pa man du bzhag pa gnyis byung ba las/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i chos skad kyi 'gros spyi khyab tu spros bral la bral thob gnyis ka yod par grags pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag gis ma zin pa'i rjes shes rgya yan pa sogs 'byung bar 'dod dgos pas sa bdun pa man chad du 'jog pa 'di 'thad par gsungs pa dang*/ ro gcig dag sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa/ sgom med chung 'bring gnyis sa bcu pa dang*/ chen po sangs rgyas kyi sar 'jog cing de bzhin du rnal 'byor gzhan gsum la yang chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du byas te bcu gnyis/

de bzhi po re re la yang ngo bo mthong ma mthong sogs rnam pa drug phye bas lam 'khrul med cig 'byung ngo*/ /'di gsang sngags bla med 'ba' zhig dang sbyar na rtse gcig chen por dpe'i 'od gsal mngon du byas nas/ spros bral gyi don gyi 'od gsal la yang nas yang du mnyam par bzhag /de las slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du byed pa yin/ zhes rje lha gzigs ras pa'i zhabs kyis gsungs pa nyid 'thad par mthong bas de ltar khas blang bar bya'o/ /tshul 'di la rje sa paṇa gyis sdom gsum rab dbyer/ de bzhin rtse gcig la sogs pa'ang*/ /mos pas spyod pa'i sa lam du/ /gsungs pa mthong na mi 'gal mod/ /'on kyang 'di 'dra bshad pa med/ /gal te 'phags pa'i sar byed na/ /mdo rgyud kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar brjod par bya ste/ rtse gcig man chad la chos nyid la gsal snang thon pa tsam ma gtogs/ mngon sum du rtogs pa med pa rgyu dus su rtse gcig tu bzhag /'bras bu sems kyi ngo bo la rtse gcig pa'i myong ba mthug po yod pas ming de ltar btags pa ni sbyor lam man du chos nyid kyi bden pa la gsal snang tsam las/ mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gnyis snang nub pa'i blo med par bstan pa dang yang mthun te/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la spros bral zhes bzhag pa ni de yan chad na chos nyid rtogs pa'i spros bral med pa min yang*/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thog ma'i ming dang*/ 'di man du mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen por snang stong gnyis kyi nang nas spros bral stong nyid kyi dran pa shas cher bsten dgos pas ming de ltar bzhag pa yin zhing*/ 'di ni sa bdun pa man du bden 'dzin gyi blo mngon gyur yang yang 'byung bar gsungs pa dang yang mthun no/ /sa brgyad pa nas mnyam rjes 'khor 'das la sogs pa'i gnyis chos thams cad zung du chud pas zung 'jug gam snang stong ro mnyam pa'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pas ro gcig ces

bya'o/ /de'i rjes su spang bya spong ba'i gnyen po yang rang sar dag nas mnyam rjes ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa la sgom med ces bya'o/ /'o na chung 'bring gnyis su gnyen pos ma dag med snyam na/ sgom med chen po'i ming gi shugs kyis smos shing*/ lha'i bu mo sked pa phra ba la sked med ma zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i don mdo rgyud dang 'gal na/ mi 'gal ba gzhan zhig byed kyis smra dgos so/ /yang 'di'i ming 'dogs gdams ngag la ma grags pas mi 'thad do zhe na/ ming dang nges tshig sbyar nas bshad pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med pas blun pos rang dgar btags pa min no/ /ming 'dogs tsam gzhan la ma grags pas rtsod na/ khyed rang lugs kyi dbang bzhi las lta ba re dang grub mtha' re 'dod par 'dug pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur la/ khyad par khyed rang gis/ pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags la/ /lta ba'i khyad par bshad pa med/ / ces mdo sngags gnyis la lta ba khyad par med par khas blangs nas bla med kyi dbang re la lta ba re byas pa yang 'gal ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /zhes rje spyan snga lha gzigs ras pas gsungs so/ /rje btsun mi la'i mgur zhig las/ so skye'i lam rang la rnal 'byor bzhi kha 'jog pa 'dra ba zhig byung rung gsung yin min dpyad gzhir snang ngo*/ /gzhan phyag chen gsar rnying gi bka' gter thams cad du rnal 'byor bzhi gsal bar byung mod/ /'on kyang rgya gzhung tshad ma mthun grub las dngos su bstan pa ni ma mthong yang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis don gyis thob pa la dgongs nas man ngag rnams su mdzad dam snyam mo/ /phyis kyi kar 'brug sgam gsum gyi phyag chen rnam bshad du/ nyan sa dang kun btus sgom rim sher phyin man ngag rnams las 'dod sems rtse gcig pa dang*/ zhi gnas kyi sems rtse gcig pa gsungs pa rnams la rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ spros bral zhes pa'i tshig ris la spros bral gyi rnal 'byor bstan par 'dod pa rnams la yid brtan yod snyam pa mi snang bas zhib tu ma spros so/

kho bo'i rnam dpyod lha lam las 'ongs pa'i/ /sa gsum mun sel snyan brgyud nyin byed 'dis/ /yang dag lta ba'i padmo kha phye bas/ /sgom chen rkang drug tshogs kyi dga' ston mdzod/ / gangs can phyag rdzogs lta ba smra ba rnams/ /phal cher blun po slu bar byed pa bzhin/ /'di las gzhan du phyag rdzogs tshul smra ba/ /lung rigs lam bzang dor bar mthong nas smras/ /gnyis pa lta ba zab mo la bag chags bzhag pa'i phyir rje btsun tsong kha pa'i bzhed pa cung zad bstan pa ni/ ji skad du mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rnams kyi ched du gnyer bya'i gtso bo ni rang don chos sku dang gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis zung 'brel gyi go 'phang yin la/ de thob par byed pa ni rigs pa drug cu pa las/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bson nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces pa ltar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu gsog pa'i lam shes pa'am/ thabs shes ya ma bral ba'i lam nyams su len pa la rag las shing*/ de ltar tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu gsog pa ni gzhi'i lta ba gtan la phebs pa na bden gnyis zung 'jug tu gtan la 'bab tshul phyin ci ma log pa zhig la nges pa rnyed pa la rag las te/ dpal ldan zla bas/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang*/ /don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa ste/ /de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog log pas lam ngan zhugs/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i shugs la/ de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis legs shes pa/ /de ni phyin ci ma log lam bzang zhugs/ /zhes bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i don yang 'di ltar/ bden gnyis zung 'jug khong du chud pa'i theg chen gyi rigs can gyi rnal 'byor pa rnams la ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi sku thob pa'i phyir du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa la snying nas gus pa lhur len par 'gyur te/

rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa las 'dod bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa 'byung ba la nges pa gting nas skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar skyes pa yang yin te/ des ni rgyu so so ba las 'bras bu so so ba ma 'chol bar 'byung ba'i rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba tha snyad bden pa'i khrigs la nges pa gting tshugs pa zhig rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa des 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i phyir du stong pa nyid phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i lta ba sgom pa la 'jug par 'gyur te/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku ni rang dang rigs mthun pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs khyad par can goms pa mthar phyin pa las byung gi /rigs mi mthun pa'i rgyu las mi 'byung la/ chos gang la yang rang gi ngo bos grub pa tha snyad du yang rdul tsam med pa la nges pa ma rnyed na ye shes kyi tshogs mtshan nyid tshang ba gsog 'dod kyang gsog par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa la stong pa nyid phyin ci ma log par nges dgos/ de la chos rnams tha snyad du'ang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas stong pa nges dgos pas/ gzhi dus su don dam bden pa gtan la 'bebs tshul la mkhas dgos so/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa la ni/ sbyin sogs thabs kyi cha rgya chen po nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu gzhan don du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku 'thob pa 'khrul med du 'byung ba la nges pa rnyed dgos/ de yang rgyu 'bras rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa rdul tsam med kyang*/ ma brtags ma dpyad par ming dang rtog pa'i dbang gis bzhag tsam la bya byed thams cad bzhag chog pa'i tha snyad tshad grub nges dgos/ de la kun rdzob bden pa'i 'jog tshul la mkhas dgos pas gzhi dus su bden gnyis zung 'jug tu gtan la 'bebs tshul ma nor bar khong du chud pa zhig dgos so/

/de nas rgyu 'bras dang bya byed thams cad tshad grub 'thad ldan du khas blang du rung ba dang*/ rang rang gi gdags gzhi'i yul steng nas grub pa cung zad kyang med pa gnyis phan tshun gcig gi grogs su gcig gyur pa'i rten 'byung stong pa dang stong pa rten 'byung du shar ba'i sgo nas/ rgol ba gzhan dag stong nyid mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan du byed pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba mi slu ba'i tshul de nyid rang lugs la stong nyid 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bor byas te nges pa drangs pas chos re re'i steng du'ang bden pa gnyis gnyis 'jog pa mi 'gal bar ma zad/ phan tshun nges pa 'dren pa'i grogs su song nas tshogs gnyis ma tshang ba med par zung 'jug tu gsog pa'i lam la 'jug pa yin no/ /las 'bras dang stong nyid kyi rnam bzhag mi 'gal bar 'jog shes pa 'di ni shin tu rtogs dka' zhing*/ rtogs na don che bar gzigs nas sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar zhal gyi bzhes pa dka' ba ltar mdzad pa yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ chos 'di zab phyir skye bo yis/ /shes par dka' ba thugs chud de/ /des na thub pa sangs rgyas nas/ /chos bstan pa las log par gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /gang dag zab mo'i don la blo'i nus pa ma sad pa rnams ni chos rnams tha snyad du rang bzhin gyis stong na gtan nas ma grub dgos pas rgyu 'bras kyi rnam bzhag rgyun chad par 'gyur la/ 'on te 'bras bu rnams rang rang gi rgyu las skyes na yul rang gi steng nas grub dgos pas rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa las 'os ci yod/ des na dngos po rnams tha snyad du rang bzhin gyis grub bo zhes 'dod do/ /'di ni bden pa gnyis ka'i rnam bzhag las nyams pas lta ba de ma bor bzhin du sangs rgyas lta zhog /thar pa tsam yang 'thob pa'i skabs med de/ dpal ldan zla bas/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/

/de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de las nyams pas thar pa 'grub yod min/ /zhes dang*/ rje mai tri bas kyang de kho na nyid bcu par/ de bzhin nyid ni shes 'dod pas/ / rnam bcas ma yin rnam med min/ /zhes yin lugs kyi de bzhin nyid shes par 'dod pas/ rnam bcas mdo sde pa dang*/ rnam med bye brag smra ba sogs kyi grub mtha' mi rigs par gsungs pa dang*/ rje mar pas kyang*/ rmongs pas stong pa chad par smra/ /dge tshogs sun 'byin chad pa'i mtha'/ /zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyis/ sems tsam mu stegs grangs can sogs/ /so so'i grub mtha' 'dod tshul rnams/ /shing skam me tog 'dod dang mtshungs/ /zhes so/ /des na skabs su bab pa bden gnyis zung 'jug tu gtan la 'bebs tshul gsal bar rjod cig ce na/ thog mar dgag bya gang bkag pas bdag med rtogs par 'dod pa'i dgag bya'i bdag ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa'am/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'am/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa la bzhed de/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa las/ de la bdag ces bya ba ni gang zhig dngos po rnams kyi gzhan la rag ma las pa'i ngo bo'i rang bzhin te/ de med pa ni bdag med pa'o/ /de ni chos dang gang zag gi dbye bas gnyis su rtogs te/ chos kyi bdag med pa dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'o zhes dang*/ buddha pā li ta las/ chos thams cad bdag med do zhes gsungs pa la/ bdag med pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni ngo bo nyid med pa'i don te/ bdag ces bya ba ni ngo bo nyid kyi tshig yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i dgag bya'i bdag ngos zin dgos te/ dper na lhas byin tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i sa phyogs su lhas byin med par nges pa la/ med rgyu'i lhas byin shes dgos pa ltar/ bdag med pa dang rang bzhin med ces pa'i don nges pa la/ med rgyu'i bdag dang rang bzhin de legs par ngos zin dgos te/ dgag par bya ba'i don spyi legs par ma shar na de 'gag pa'i bdag med kyi don mi nges pa'i phyir te/

spyod 'jug las/ btags pa'i dngos la ma reg par/ /de yi dngos med 'dzin ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de yang gang zag gam chos gang yang rung ba rnams la nang gi blo'i dbang gis bzhag pa tsam min par chos de rnams la rang rang gi gdags gzhi'i yul gyi steng nas/ rang rang gi ngos nas gnas tshul lam/ sdod tshul tshugs thub tu ling nge grub par 'dzin pa ni lhan skyes kyi ma rig pas rang bzhin gyis grub par sgro 'dogs tshul yin pas/ des ji ltar bzung ba'i chos rnams kyi rang rang gi sdod lugs de la ni dgag bya'i bdag gam/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa zhes brtag pa mtha' bzung gi sgo nas ngos 'dzin pa yin te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ 'di kun rang dbang med pa ste/ /des na bdag ni yod ma yin/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ 'di na gang rang gi ngo bo dang rang bzhin dang rang dbang dang gzhan la rag ma las pa nyid yin pa de la ni zhes de dag rnams grangs su gsungs so/ /gzhan la rag ma las pa rgyu rkyen la rag ma las pa zhes pa'i don min gyi/ yul can tha snyad pa'i shes pa la gzhan zhes bya ste/ de'i dbang gis bzhag pa min pas gzhan la rag ma las pa zhes so/ /des na rang dbang ba zhes bya ste yul de dag rang rang gi sdod lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo bo'o/ /de nyid la rang gi ngo bo ma grub pa'i ngo bo dang rang gi rang bzhin zhes bya'o/ /de'i phyir rtog pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa min par rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas yul gyi steng du grub pa zhig byung na de la dgag bya'i bdag ces bya bas/ 'di 'gog pa ni bya bas phongs nas 'gog pa min gyi/ dgag bya de ltar grub par zhen pa'i rtog pa des sems can rnams rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'ching ba mthong nas/ de'i zhen yul sun 'byin pa'i sgo nas ma rig pa de spong ba yin te/ sems can 'khor bar 'ching bar byed pa'i ma rig pa ni lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa yin pa'i phyir ro/

/des na dgag bya de 'gog pa ni/ dper na thag khra la sbrul du 'khrul nas skrag par byed pa na/ blo des ji ltar bzung ba ltar gyi sbrul med par nges nas 'khrul ba de bzlog dgos kyi/ gzhan bya thabs med pa ltar bden 'dzin lhan skyes kyis yul rang ngos nas grub par bzung ba ltar gyi yul de med par rgyu mtshan yang dag gi nges nas de'i don la 'dris par byed dgos la/ bden 'dzin lhan skyes des ji ltar bzung ba'i yul de med pa yang dam bca' tsam gyis mi 'grub pas lung dang rigs pa'i tshogs dri ma med pa rnams kyis de sgrub par byed pa yin no/ /de yang so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis dpyad pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas yul bden par med pa nyid las gzhan du mi rtog pa dgos kyi/ cir yang mi rtog pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ sgom rim mtha' ma las/ de lta bas na dam pa'i chos las dran pa med pa dang*/ yid la byed pa med par yang yang dag par so sor rtog pa sngon du 'gro ba yin par blta bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir yang dag par so sor rtog pa nyid kyis dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa med par byed nus kyi/ gzhan du ma yin no zhes dang*/ sgom rim bar pa las kyang*/ des de ltar shes rab kyis rnam par dpyad de/ gang gi tshe rnal 'byor pas dngos po dag gi ngo bo nyid don dam par nges par mi 'dzin pa de'i tshe rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug go /chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid med pa nyid kyang rtogs so/ /gang zhig shes rab kyis dngos po'i ngo bo nyid so sor brtags nas mi sgom gyi/ yid la byed pa yongs su spangs pa tsam 'ba' zhig sgom par byed pa de'i rnam par rtog pa nam yang mi bzlog cing*/ ngo bo nyid med pa nyid nam yang rtogs par mi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi snang ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /des na don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad mthar chos gang yang mi rnyed kyang*/

ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i tha snyad du ming tsam la/ rgyu las 'bras bu skye ba sogs kyi bya byed thams cad tshad grub tu bzhag chog pa la nges pa drangs te/ tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu gsog pa la slob pa yin no zhes bzhed pa yin no/ /de skad du yang lam rim chen mo las/ de dag rnams kyi dri ma med pa'i lugs/ /rang bzhin med pa sgyu 'dra'i dngos po la/ /'khor 'das rten 'brel bya byed 'thad pa'i tshul/ /cung zad tsam zhig go sla'i ngag gis bshad/ /zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung la sbyangs pa'i grogs/ khyod kyi blo ngor rang bzhin med pa la/ / rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'jog pa dka' mod kyang*/ /de 'dra dbu ma'i lugs ni yin no zhes/ /de skad smra ba'i tshul la brten na mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /'di nas sangs rgyas sa ru bgrod pa la/ /'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang*/ /pha rol phyin pa rgyu yi theg pa gnyis/ /de don snying po nyams su len tshul la/ /dbu ma chen po phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba rnam gsum zhes/ /sngon byon lo paṇa rnams la yongs su grags/ / 'on kyang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ /gsang sngags bla med lkog chos snyan brgyud las/ /yongs grags sgyur ba re zhig bkag pa yis/ /phyi nas yongs dag rnam gsum rnying ma rnams/ /rgya bsgyur min zhes rtsod pa can du gyur/ /de slad phyag chen rdzogs chen bka' gter la/ /yang dag pa dang ltar snang 'ga' byung yang*/ /'dir ni rig 'dzin pad 'byung bi ma la'i/ /rjes su 'brang ba'i mkhas grub du ma dang*/ /dam pa sangs rgyas mar pa mi la dang*/ /dwags po lha rje yab sras bzhed pa rnams/ /gcig tu byas nas slob ma 'khrid pa'i tshul/ /dam pa'i rnam sprul sangs rgyas brtson 'grus kyis/ /skal bzang skye bo'i tshogs la gsungs pa bzhin/ /yang dag lung dang dri med rigs pa yis/ /snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu 'di bsgrubs pas/
